name: Focused Study

choices.label: Focused Study: the skill of its 1st-level Skill Focus

text: **Focused Study**: All humans are skillful, but some, rather than being generalists, tend to specialize in a handful of skills. At 1st, 8th, and 16th level, such humans gain Skill Focus in a skill of their choice as a bonus feat. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

feats.name: Skill Focus ({choice:focus})
feats.description:
Choose a skill. You are particularly adept at that skill.

**Benefit**: You get a +3 bonus on all checks involving the chosen skill. If you have 10 or more ranks in that skill, this bonus increases to +6.

**Special**: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new skill.
